set.name: Rising Arcade
set.mechanism: The m in nomow steps up: two arches that share a leg, the right one higher; the wordmark repeats the emerald once, in a solid first o, on today's navy.
set.expression_move: The stepped m symbol is the only loud thing; type and colour stay as calm as today's app.
set.differs_by: PropSpace is blue, Bitrix24 lime, Zoho and HubSpot black; emerald is free on this shelf, and none of them uses a symbol built from its own letters.

logo.concept: An arcade of two arches, the right one a step higher: the m of nomow, two doorways, and this month above the last. In the wordmark the first o is a solid emerald dot.
logo.defect: User asked for a designed wordmark; stepped letters, door and keyhole details were rejected; the solid emerald first o was kept.

misuse.label: Don't level the arches: the right one always steps up

defaults_used.why: Existing asset: the app's sidebar navy #0f172a, which the user asked to keep; here it is the text and sidebar colour, and emerald is the brand colour.

rationale.claim: Emerald is unused by the measured competitors (blue, lime, black, black).
Keeps the current app colours, so the product does not need a visual migration.
rationale.source: user brief: likes the current look

rationale.claim: Alexandria and Alan Sans both draw Arabic and Latin, so the Arabic UI uses the same faces.

palette.name: Rising Arcade
palette.direction: Today's emerald on slate navy, tuned.

set.name: Hidden Figures
set.mechanism: Numbers stay hidden until you choose to look: the two o's of nomow are filled into dots like masked digits, set in one sober grotesk whose figures are tabular by default, on deep night ink.
set.expression_move: The two emerald dots are the only colour on an almost black-and-white identity.
set.differs_by: Competitors sell openness and dashboards; this is the only discreet, dark, wordmark-only route, built on the product's hidden-by-default numbers.

logo.concept: The name with its numbers hidden: both o's become solid dots, the way the app masks figures until you tap to show them.
logo.defect: Round 1: the o's were still open; filled both into emerald dots and resized the small n-dot mark to the wordmark's proportions. Round 2: #10b981 fell under 3:1 on white, so the dots turned black there; deepened to #059669.

defaults_used.why: Existing asset deepened: the app's navy #0f172a taken to night ink so the dark ground carries the discreet idea; the user asked to keep the current colours.

rationale.claim: The dots echo a shipped feature: performance numbers are hidden by default and re-hide after a minute idle.
IBM Plex Sans Arabic has tabular figures by default and a distinct I/l/1, which suits tables of prices and targets.
The current dark-mode emerald #10b981 becomes the only accent, so dark mode is the brand's home.

palette.name: Hidden Figures
palette.direction: Night ink and white, with one emerald for the dots.

brand.name: Signal Emerald
brand.usage: the dots; focus and success states only (3:1 on white and on night ink)

set.name: Nūn
set.mechanism: The first letter in both scripts: an Arabic nūn (a bowl with one dot) as the symbol, one humanist family named after old Cairo for both languages, and emerald used as large surfaces on a pale green ground.
set.expression_move: Big bilingual type: Arabic and English set at the same size, side by side, everywhere the brand speaks.
set.differs_by: Every measured competitor is Latin-only and imported; this route is Arabic-first and Egyptian, without navy or any listed default.

logo.concept: نـ: the bowl and dot of the Arabic n, which opens نومو; upside down, the bowl is the Latin n that opens nomow.
logo.defect: Round 1: a symmetric bowl under a dot read as a smiley; the right horn now rises with a slanted cut, as the calligraphic nūn does.

rationale.claim: None of the four measured competitor sites sets Arabic in its brand; the product will ship an Arabic UI.
The rhombus dot is the calligraphic nūn dot; a round dot over a bowl reads as a person with raised arms.
Fustat covers Arabic and Latin with tabular figures in one variable file (~36 KB).

palette.name: Nūn
palette.direction: Emerald as surfaces on a pale green ground, deep teal ink instead of navy.

brand.name: Nūn Green
brand.usage: symbol bowl, large surfaces, primary buttons
